title: Air Hockey 3D with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a 3D air hockey game using Three.js with time control mechanics. Follow these specifications precisely:

## Scene Setup
- Use Three.js with GLTFLoader from CDN (unpkg or jsdelivr)
- Create a perspective camera at position (0, 8, 10) looking down at the table
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light from (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0
- Background color: #1a1a2e

## Air Hockey Table
- Create a rectangular table (width: 8, depth: 12, height: 0.3) using a green (#2d6a4f) MeshStandardMaterial
- Add white boundary walls (height: 0.4, thickness: 0.2) around all four edges
- Add a center line (white, thin plane) across the middle of the table
- Add two goal zones: one at z = -6 (opponent's goal) and one at z = 6 (player's goal), each 2.5 units wide with no wall segment

## Dragon Trophy (3D Asset)
- Load 'DragonAttenuation.glb' using GLTFLoader
- Scale the model to fit roughly 1.5 units tall
- Place it at position (5, 1.5, 0) beside the table as a decorative trophy
- Apply a slow rotation animation (0.5 rad/s around Y axis)
- When a player scores 3 goals (wins), make the dragon glow by changing its emissive color to gold (#ffd700)

## Game Objects
- **Puck**: A red (#e63946) cylinder (radius: 0.3, height: 0.15) placed at center (0, 0.375, 0)
- **Player Paddle**: A blue (#457b9d) cylinder (radius: 0.5, height: 0.2) at (0, 0.4, 4)
- **AI Paddle**: A purple (#7b2d8e) cylinder (radius: 0.5, height: 0.2) at (0, 0.4, -4)

## Physics & Movement
- The puck moves with velocity, bouncing off walls with coefficient of restitution 0.9
- Apply slight friction (multiply velocity by 0.998 each frame)
- Player paddle follows mouse X position (raycasted onto the table plane), constrained to z: [1, 5.5] and x: [-3.5, 3.5]
- AI paddle tracks puck X with slight delay (lerp factor 0.03), constrained to z: [-5.5, -1] and x: [-3.5, 3.5]
- Paddle-puck collision: when distance < sum of radii, reflect puck velocity and add paddle influence
- Puck speed is capped at 15 units/s

## Time Control Feature
- Implement a time scale system with values: 0.25x (slow-mo), 0.5x, 1.0x (normal), 2.0x (fast)
- Press '1' for 0.25x, '2' for 0.5x, '3' for 1.0x, '4' for 2.0x
- All physics (puck movement, AI tracking, friction) must multiply by the current timeScale
- Display current time scale on the HUD

## Scoring & Game State
- When puck crosses z > 6 (enters player goal): opponent scores
- When puck crosses z < -6 (enters opponent goal): player scores
- After a goal, reset puck to center with zero velocity after 1 second delay
- First to 3 goals wins. Show 'YOU WIN!' or 'YOU LOSE!' message
- Press 'R' to reset the entire game

## HUD / UI
- Display at top-center: 'Player: X | Opponent: Y' with white text, 24px font
- Display time scale indicator: 'Time: Xx' at top-right corner
- Display game status ('Playing', 'Goal!', 'YOU WIN!', 'YOU LOSE!') at center when relevant
- Add a 'Reset Game' button (id='resetBtn') at bottom-center

## State Management (CRITICAL)
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ object updated every frame with:
  - playerScore: number (0-3)
  - opponentScore: number (0-3)
  - puckPosition: {x, y, z}
  - puckVelocity: {x, y, z}
  - puckSpeed: number (magnitude of velocity)
  - playerPaddleX: number
  - aiPaddleX: number
  - timeScale: number (0.25, 0.5, 1.0, or 2.0)
  - gameStatus: string ('playing', 'goal', 'playerWin', 'opponentWin')
  - dragonLoaded: boolean
  - dragonGlowing: boolean
  - isPaused: boolean (true during goal reset delay)
  - totalGoals: number (sum of both scores)
  - frameCount: number (increments each animation frame)
  - puckOnTable: boolean (true if puck within table bounds)
physics_constraints: Puck must bounce off walls with restitution 0.9. Friction factor 0.998 per frame (scaled by timeScale). Puck speed capped at 15 units/s. Paddle-puck collision uses circle-circle detection. All physics timesteps scaled by timeScale factor. Puck and paddles must remain within table boundaries.
